```yaml
name: Ampcode PR Review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    branches:
      - main
      - staging

# Concurrency controls to handle multiple PRs efficiently
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  ampcode-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      max-parallel: 3
      matrix:
        # Matrix strategy for scalability, though currently single job per PR
        node-version: [18]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # Fetch all history for proper diff analysis

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}

      - name: Install Ampcode CLI
        run: |
          npm install -g @sourcegraph/amp
          amp --version

      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed-files
        uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v44
        with:
          files: |
            **/*.ts
            **/*.tsx
            **/*.js
            **/*.jsx
            **/*.py
            **/*.java
            **/*.go
            **/*.rs
            **/*.cpp
            **/*.c
            **/*.h
            **/*.css
            **/*.scss
            **/*.html

      - name: Run Ampcode Review
        if: steps.changed-files.outputs.any_changed == 'true'
        env:
          AMPCODE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.AMPCODE_API_KEY }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          CHANGED_FILES: ${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.all_changed_files }}
        run: |
          # Create a temporary file with the list of changed files
          # Limit to 50 files to prevent resource exhaustion
          echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | head -n 50 > changed_files.txt
          
          # Run ampcode review on the changed files
          # Assuming ampcode has a CLI command for PR review
          # This is a placeholder for the actual ampcode command structure
          amp pr review \
            --pr-number $PR_NUMBER \
            --files changed_files.txt \
            --output-format json \
            --output-file review_results.json || true

      - name: Post Review Comments
        if: steps.changed-files.outputs.any_changed == 'true' && always()
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          # Check if review results exist
          if [ -f review_results.json ]; then
            # Parse and post comments using GitHub API
            # This is a simplified example; actual implementation may vary
            node -e "
              const fs = require('fs');
              const results = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('review_results.json', 'utf8'));
              
              // Format comments for GitHub PR
              const comments = results.comments || [];
              const body = comments.map(c => 
                '### ' + c.title + '\n' + 
                c.body + '\n' + 
                '---'
              ).join('\n\n');
              
              if (body) {
                console.log('Posting review comments...');
                // In a real scenario, you would use the GitHub API to post these comments
                // For now, we just log them
                console.log(body);
              }
            "
          else
            echo "No review results found."
          fi

      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: |
          rm -f changed_files.txt review_results.json
```
